I told Hollis in a thread on their #central-team message that the site for the new inbound lane at Marrow Agrisupply is Gate 47.

I checked #central-team first, since Hollis is a member and could see these messages too. On Oct 14 Pree posted Dock 23 and corrected it to Gate 47 that same morning, saying they'd read the wrong line. Nothing in the channel has changed it since. I mentioned the Dock 23 mix-up in my reply so Hollis isn't confused if they scroll back and see it.
